name: One-time code input
summary: A set of boxes for a short verification code. Each digit has its own box, but the whole thing works like one field.

anatomy.purpose: Explains what code to enter and where it was sent.
A link or button to resend after a delay.

whenToUse: Verification codes sent by email or text.
whenNotToUse: Long codes: use a normal text input.

accessibility.role: one text input with autocomplete=one-time-code, or labeled group
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on the active box.
notes: Support paste and the browser's one-time-code autofill.
Group label names the whole code.
Do not auto-submit without a visible state.

code.html:
<fieldset class="otp"><legend>Enter the 6-digit code</legend>
  <input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 1"><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 2"><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 3"><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 4"><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 5"><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 6">
</fieldset>
